FAST

Nov 5 : Anthropic's AI models are improving nearly twice as fast as before as the technology plays a bigger role in developing more powerful versions of itself, an independent study found, fanning concerns that advances could outpace efforts to assess risks. The findings from AI safety nonprofit METR, published on Thursday, offer some of the clearest evidence yet that AI is accelerating its own development, potentially paving the way for recursive self-improvement (RSI), when AI systems can build more powerful versions of themselves without human intervention. METR estimated AI accounted for perhaps 80 per cent of the current acceleration, though it cautioned that the figure was uncertain. The researchers found no convincing evidence of major bottlenecks that could slow progress over the next year. "We are confident that the acceleration was not due to an acceleration in the scaling of training compute," METR, also known Model Evaluation and Threat Research, said.

But it cautioned that AI was not yet capable of making highly significant, fully autonomous contributions to the most important stages of model training. The prospect of recursive self-improvement has fueled warnings from AI researchers in recent months that such systems could become difficult to align with human goals, monitor and control, potentially posing an existential threat to humanity. Such a shift could have far-reaching implications for an industry that has spent hundreds of billions of dollars building computing infrastructure to train advanced models as AI itself could become an important driver of technological progress. METR's 11-week assessment, which drew on confidential research, interviews and performance data from unreleased models, found Anthropic's benchmark capabilities had been improving 1.9 times faster since October 2025 than previously.

Source: Reuters

SAO PAULO, Nov 5 : Japan's Honda will invest 3.3 billion reais ($602.2 million) by 2030 to expand the capacity of its motorcycle plant in Brazil, the company said in a statement on Thursday. • The move includes two new production units at its Manaus complex, increasing annual capacity to 2.3 million units in 2029 from an expected 1.6 million this year, it said • The factory produces 20 models, serving the domestic market and exporting to 19 countries, including to the US and Mexico, according to Honda • The investment adds to 1.6 billion reais announced last year by the group into its motorcycle business in Brazil ($1 = 5.4798 reais)

item.title: Hackers mueven casi US$1.000 millones de las criptomonedas robadas a Binance por redes de lavado
item.description: Chainalysis rastreó cientos de miles de dólares del botín hacia redes chinas de blanqueo de capitales. Los atacantes han movido unos US$500 millones a través de la blockchain TRON.
item.dc:creator: Micah Barkley, Ben Weiss
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los piratas informáticos responsables del robo de US$6.300 millones a Binance Holdings Ltd. están moviendo parte de las criptomonedas sustraídas a través de redes chinas de blanqueo de capitales, según la empresa de análisis de cadenas de bloques Chainalysis. Se ha observado que los piratas informáticos, identificados por las autoridades estadounidenses como miembros del grupo norcoreano TraderTraitor, están transfiriendo los activos sustraídos a través de miles de monederos digitales y por múltiples cadenas de bloques, en un intento por ocultar su origen. Se afirma que los piratas informáticos norcoreanos también han utilizado redes chinas de blanqueo de capitales en robos anteriores, y Chainalysis ha señalado que ha rastreado cómo cientos de miles de dólares procedentes del robo a Binance —una fracción del total sustraído— fluyen hacia estas redes. Ver más: Cómo hackearon a Binance: una falsa entrevista de trabajo y software malicioso estuvieron detrás Los flujos hacia las redes de blanqueo de capitales, que incluyen mesas de negociación extrabursátiles, sugieren que los piratas informáticos están tratando de retirar fondos de las cadenas de bloques y convertirlos en efectivo, según Chainalysis. Gran parte de la actividad general ha consistido en dividir los fondos en cantidades más pequeñas, intercambiar criptomonedas y transferir activos entre blockchains. Corea del Norte ha negado estar detrás del ataque. Según Chainalysis, los piratas informáticos ya han movido unos US$500 millones a través de la cadena de bloques TRON. Los atacantes han repartido ese dinero entre más de 1.000 direcciones, utilizando diversos protocolos de negociación en TRON —que también se ha utilizado para transacciones ilícitas— para trasladar los fondos a carteras en Ethereum, Bitcoin y otras redes. Binance está colaborando con las fuerzas del orden, empresas de inteligencia de cadenas de bloques, emisores de monedas estables y otras entidades para rastrear y congelar los activos relacionados con el ataque, según ha declarado un portavoz por correo electrónico. Ver más: Binance aumenta los incentivos para los creadores de mercado tras hackeo de US$6.300 millones “Es de esperar que se produzcan intentos de blanqueo tras un ataque de esta magnitud, pero no pasan desapercibidos”, ha señalado el portavoz. “Cada movimiento en la cadena de bloques genera nueva información para que Binance, las fuerzas del orden, las empresas de análisis de blockchain, los emisores y los socios del sector puedan rastrear, señalar y congelar activos”. Un portavoz de TRON DAO señaló que la empresa cuenta con un sólido historial de colaboración con las fuerzas del orden y las empresas de análisis para “combatir el uso de la tecnología blockchain con fines ilícitos”. “Como protocolo descentralizado de código abierto, TRON es utilizado por terceros independientes, lo cual, al igual que ocurre con cualquier tecnología de éxito, puede dar lugar a abusos por parte de personas malintencionadas”, añadió el portavoz de la empresa. Ver más: Binance registra retiros por US$4.700 millones tras un hackeo sin precedentes Las empresas del sector de las criptomonedas han congelado unos US$3.000 millones de los activos robados, lo que impide a los piratas informáticos mover los fondos. Otros US$2.420 millones en criptomonedas procedentes del ataque a Binance se encuentran en Bitcoin y Ether, fondos que los atacantes apenas han movido desde el ataque. Los activos restantes, que suman casi US$1.000 millones, han comenzado a circular a través de lo que, según Chainalysis, son canales de blanqueo. Binance reveló el robo el 29 de octubre, en lo que se ha convertido en el mayor ataque informático a una plataforma de criptomonedas de la historia. La plataforma de intercambio afirmó el martes que los atacantes utilizaron tácticas de ingeniería social, entre ellas entrevistas de trabajo falsas y software malicioso, para acceder a sus sistemas. Chainalysis señaló que, hasta la fecha, solo una cantidad insignificante de los activos robados parece haber fluido hacia redes chinas de blanqueo de capitales. La empresa prevé que los atacantes continúen convirtiendo las criptomonedas y, finalmente, intenten obtener liquidez a través de corredores y plataformas de intercambio, un proceso que podría llevar meses. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Lightspeed Commerce reports US$4.2M Q2 loss, revenue up from year ago
item.description: Lightspeed Commerce Inc. reported a loss of US$4.2 million in its latest quarter compared with a loss of US$32.7 million a year ago.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: MONTREAL — Lightspeed Commerce Inc.’s share price dropped roughly 14 per cent on the heels of the company revealing its latest quarter brought a US$4.2 million loss. The commerce technology company’s share price fell to $13.77 after it revealed the loss, which compared with a $32.7 million hit a year ago. Despite reporting a loss, Lightspeed’s chief executive insisted Thursday that a recent pivot to more “upmarket” clients has put the company on the path to success. Dax Dasilva told analysts there are “clear signals that the merchants we are winning are higher quality and more deeply attached to our software.” Since Dasilva, Lightspeed’s founder, returned to the helm in 2024, the company has been working to refocus its client base around North American retail and European hospitality. On the retail front, it recently attracted apparel company Bombas, the Hockey Hall of Fame in Toronto and the International Spy Museum in Washington, D.C. Its newest hospitality clients include the McManus Pub Co. in the U.K., Domaine & Demeure’s luxury chateaus and restaurants and the Indie Group’s bars. Many of the businesses are the kind of large, sophisticated clients Lightspeed wants to lure in because they tend to buy more software. “Larger, more established customers drive higher software payments revenue, stay with us longer and are better positioned to benefit from Lightspeed’s more advanced feature sets,” Dasilva explained. “In general, they provide higher lifetime value.” His remarks dovetailed with the release of Lightspeed’s results, which are calculated in U.S. dollars. Its quarterly loss amounted to three cents US per diluted share for the quarter ended Sept. 30 compared with a loss of 24 cents US per diluted share a year earlier. On an adjusted basis, it earned 17 cents US per share in its latest quarter compared with an adjusted profit of 16 cents US share a year ago. Revenue totalled US$323.8 million, up from US$319 million in the same quarter last year. Subscription revenue for the quarter reached US$97.8 million, up from US$93.5 million a year ago, while transaction-based revenue amounted to US$213.9 million, down from US$215.8 million in the same quarter last year. Hardware and other revenue was US$12.2 million, up from US$9.7 million. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 5, 2026. By Tara Deschamps

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 5 : The US Federal Aviation Administration said on Thursday it will replace by the end of 2028 the outdated floppy disks used for weather and other critical information at more than 400 air traffic control facilities across the country.  The Enterprise Information Display System will replace four systems dating back to the 1980s and will put important operational information in one place so controllers can quickly see air traffic updates. Floppy disks largely stopped being used more than 25 years ago and have not been produced in large numbers since 2011. Congress last year approved $12.5 billion to fix the aging US air traffic control system and Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy wants another $30 billion for additional upgrades as the FAA deals with numerous technology issues. “We’re moving away from outdated, manual processes and replacing technology that once relied on floppy disks with a modern system that allows controllers to instantly share critical flight alerts, restricted airspace schedules and pilot reports," FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said in a statement.

In a previously unreported October 23 FAA memo to airports seen by Reuters, the agency said "there have been a number of recent air traffic control outages due to fiber optic cable cuts, which can lead to delays, diversions and cancellations" and urged coordination with the FAA on projects. The FAA cited an October 13 event where a fiber optic cable connecting Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport to the FAA’s network was cut outside an airport gate, leading to the loss of data services between FAA facilities and requiring a ground stop. In September, thousands of flights across the densely populated Northeast were delayed or canceled due to the dual failures of a circuit at a Philadelphia air traffic facility and the accidental severing of a fiber-optic cable in New Jersey by a construction crew. DECADES-OLD COMPUTERS AND SPARE PARTS FROM EBAY The FAA relies on telecoms systems it is racing to replace as well as decades-old Compaq computers and replacement parts bought on eBay. The US has the world's most complex airspace and faces a shortage of several thousand air traffic controllers. The country's air traffic facilities cannot talk to one another and operate on individual analog computers. "Every facility is a silo," Bedford told Reuters in a recent interview. The FAA has also been working for years to end a long-ridiculed, decades-old practice of air traffic controllers using paper flight strips to keep track of aircraft. But adopting the change, which started in 2022, at 49 major airports will take until at least 2028. A total of 27 major airports have already done away with the paper strips.

Source: Reuters

WASHINGTON, Nov 5 : The United States is warning of an "ongoing cyber threat" to industrial refrigeration systems, saying in a statement issued Thursday that every organization that depends on cold storage should assume it could fall into the hackers' crosshairs. The statement said that unidentified "malicious cyber actors" were targeting vulnerabilities in internet-accessible electronic temperature and commercial refrigeration controllers in retail grocery and cold storage facilities. "If successfully exploited, the actors could change the temperature and possibly cause physical impacts such as fire hazards, loss of inventory and changes to the service life of the system," said the statement, which was issued by the FBI, the cyber defense agency CISA, and other government departments. "Every organization that depends on refrigeration and monitoring systems should assume it could be a target," said Chris Butera, CISA's acting executive assistant director for cybersecurity.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 5 : The Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Wall Street's industry regulator, said on Thursday it fined Webull Financial $4.2 million for failing to implement programs aimed at preventing illicit finance and other issues. • Between January 2020 and September 2023, the digital brokerage did not implement reasonably designed programs to prevent money laundering and identity theft, FINRA said. • The firm did not have reasonable policies in place, for example, to verify customer identities when they signed up for accounts, FINRA said. • Webull also did not establish policies and procedures to detect and flag suspicious transactions, FINRA said. • The firm also failed to institute a program to make sure customer transactions were done in the best way for the customers, FINRA said. • Webull, which did not admit or deny FINRA's findings, did not respond immediately to requests for comment. • As part of the settlement, Webull has agreed to remediate issues and hire an independent consultant.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Codelco prepara una reestructuración para recuperar la confianza tras escándalo de producción
item.description: El presidente del directorio, Bernardo Fontaine, propondrá cambios que van más allá del gobierno corporativo, mientras la minera enfrenta una menor producción, mayores costos y una deuda récord.
item.dc:creator: James Attwood
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El presidente del directorio de Codelco propondrá una reestructuración de la minera estatal chilena que iría más allá del gobierno corporativo, en un intento por recuperar la confianza tras un escándalo por irregularidades en las cifras de producción. “El año que viene pretendo proponer una serie de cambios, no a la gobernanza solamente, porque esto no es un problema solamente de gobernanza, sino que es la posibilidad de repensar Codelco, de repensar la estructura de Codelco”, dijo Bernardo Fontaine a periodistas tras una junta extraordinaria de accionistas el jueves, sin dar más detalles. La iniciativa forma parte de un esfuerzo más amplio para contener el impacto de las irregularidades en los reportes y reforzar la supervisión, mientras Codelco enfrenta una menor producción, mayores costos y una deuda récord. Ver más: Codelco despide a ocho ejecutivos y empleados por nuevas irregularidades en sus cifras de producción Los ministros presentes en la reunión pidieron a la empresa profundizar las investigaciones y evaluar cambios en su gobierno corporativo. La última gran reforma, en 2009, buscó profesionalizar el directorio y darle mayor independencia del gobierno. Las cifras presentadas el jueves muestran que la producción reportada en 2024 y 2025 fue inflada artificialmente en 42.100 toneladas métricas de cobre: 24.000 toneladas en 2024 y 18.100 toneladas netas el año pasado. Los hallazgos preliminares incluyen producción contabilizada dos veces entre las divisiones Salvador y Ministro Hales, además de producción de Chuquicamata informada antes de que efectivamente se produjera. Ver más: Codelco investiga irregularidades que podrían haber inflado su producción de cobre Las irregularidades generarían en 2026 un ajuste a la baja de inventarios de unas 17.000 toneladas, equivalente a entre US$120 millones y US$140 millones, según una presentación realizada en la reunión. Por separado, Codelco dijo que la duplicación había inflado los inventarios en 18.800 toneladas. El ministro de Hacienda, Jorge Quiroz, pidió llevar las investigaciones hasta sus “últimas consecuencias”. Dijo que el directorio anterior había cuestionado cifras anómalas de producción, pero recibió información falsa de la administración. Ver más: Codelco y Pucobre crean una alianza para desarrollar proyecto de US$870 millones en Chile Codelco despidió a ocho ejecutivos la semana pasada y contrató a EY y KPMG para realizar auditorías. La investigación surgió de un caso separado relacionado con casi 27.000 toneladas contabilizadas como producción de 2025 pese a no cumplir los requisitos para ser consideradas producto terminado, y desde entonces se ha ampliado. El escándalo aumenta la urgencia de una transformación más amplia. Fontaine dijo que Codelco espera producir algo más de 1,2 millones de toneladas este año, por debajo de la proyección oficial, y que la producción de sus minas promediaría cerca de 1,3 millones de toneladas en los próximos cuatro años. La administración está adoptando proyecciones más realistas y trasladando el foco del volumen a la rentabilidad. Codelco buscará crecer mediante alianzas público-privadas y revisará sus participaciones minoritarias en otros negocios, dijo Fontaine. La minera evaluará si vender algunas de ellas y reinvertir los recursos en sus propias operaciones generaría mejores retornos. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

Nov 5 : The parents of a girl in the US who used Google’s Gemini AI chatbot on her school-provided Chromebook to make a plan to die by suicide have sued the company, claiming it pushed its AI products on students and failed to warn of their dangers.  • The girl, identified as “Emma,” began using Gemini on her Chromebook when she was 13 • Emma discussed different methods of suicide with Gemini and planned a funeral for herself while the bot helped her conceal her feelings from her family, the lawsuit claims • Parents say they were alerted after school software flagged a document Emma wrote about her funeral plans, according to the lawsuit

• In a race to expand the audience for Gemini, Google wove the AI into all of its products without warning parents or schools, the lawsuit says • Google knew Gemini 3 Flash, the version Emma used, was unsafe and mishandled mental health issues from users, the lawsuit says • José Castañeda, a spokesperson for Google, said the company is reviewing the claims • "We’ve worked extensively with medical professionals and academic experts to build features that help young people find critical support and trusted resources when they need it," Castañeda said • The lawsuit, which seeks monetary damages, was filed Monday in California state court. Google moved it to federal court on Wednesday • Google said this week it will turn off Gemini by default for school student accounts, but schools that want students to retain access to Google Search will still have to accept AI features such as AI-generated summaries

item.title: El presidente de Paraguay, Santiago Peña, renuncia tras la quiebra de Ueno Bank
item.description: La renuncia se produjo mientras el Congreso debatía un pedido de juicio político contra el mandatario, en medio de protestas por la quiebra de Ueno Bank, entidad financiera vinculada al Gobierno parag ...
item.dc:creator: Carlos Cuevas
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg Línea — El presidente de Paraguay, Santiago Peña, renunció a su cargo este jueves, en medio del escándalo y una creciente ola de protestas por la quiebra de Ueno Bank, la sexta entidad bancaria más grande del país, que está vinculada a su Gobierno. Peña, de 47 años, dio un paso al costado mientras la Cámara de Diputados de Paraguay debatía un pedido de juicio político en su contra. Lo hizo tras poco más de tres años en el poder, de cinco establecidos en la Constitución. La bancada del Partido Colorado, dividido en facciones y al que pertenece Peña, adelantó que acompañaría el juicio político , que podría avanzar hacia el Senado y abrir un proceso de destitución. El exmandatario paraguayo y presidente de la Asociación Nacional Republicana —Partido Colorado—, Horacio Cartes, anunció que la agrupación política le retiraba el apoyo a Peña, asegurando que la colectividad no estaría del lado del “latrocinio de los fondos públicos, privados y de los jubilados”. “La bandera colorada representa una historia de servicio al país; honrarla también significa actuar con valentía cuando la patria lo exige”, añadió Cartes en X. Ver más: Quiebra de Ueno Bank sacude a Paraguay: miles reclaman sus ahorros y el Congreso debate destituir a Peña En ese contexto, horas después y a través de un video publicado en sus redes sociales, Peña comunicó que dejaba su cargo. “Hoy me dirijo a ustedes en uno de los momentos más difíciles de mi vida, con el corazón puesto en el Paraguay y la convicción de que nuestra república siempre debe estar por encima de cualquier persona”, sostuvo el mandatario. “He tomado la decisión de presentar mi renuncia a la Presidencia de la República; lo hago pensando en la estabilidad de nuestro país, la paz social y la necesidad de preservar las instituciones democráticas”. Quienes apuntan contra Santiago Peña sostienen que incurrió en conflictos de intereses al utilizar su posición como presidente para favorecer a Ueno Bank, entidad con la que había mantenido vínculos patrimoniales a través del grupo que la controlaba, del que se desvinculó en 2025. A falta de que el Congreso acepte la renuncia de Peña, el vicepresidente de la nación sudamericana, Pedro Alliana, sería su sucesor. No obstante, deberá esperar cómo sale librado de un proceso de destitución que afronta en la Cámara de Diputados. Las autoridades reguladoras paraguayas cerraron el Ueno Bank a primera hora del martes, tras el desplome de su índice de solvencia. Lo sucedido provocó la dimisión del presidente del Banco Central, Carlos Carvallo, quien era presidente de la empresa predecesora de la entidad crediticia cuando Peña le nombró al frente de la autoridad monetaria. También suscitó una creciente ola de protestas en la capital paraguaya, Asunción, pues los titulares de cuentas de Ueno no podían acceder a sus ahorros. El banco atendía a uno de cada tres paraguayos y procesaba más de 3 millones de transacciones diarias, según Bloomberg. Antes de la intervención del banco central, Peña había restado importancia a las preocupaciones sobre la entidad crediticia, en cuya sociedad matriz había invertido hasta el año 2025. Hoy, sin embargo, pidió disculpas al ”pueblo" y dijo que “nunca fue su intención defraudar la confianza” depositada por los paraguayos cuando votaron por él. “Mi prioridad es una sola: la tranquilidad de los paraguayos que confiaron sus ahorros en nuestro sistema financiero. Detrás de cada depósito hay años de esfuerzo, sacrificio y proyectos familiares. Mi mayor deseo es que se garantice la devolución de esos recursos”, agregó Peña en su mensaje. Ver más: Dólar se dispara en Paraguay: guaraní es la moneda que más cae en el mundo por juicio a Peña y crisis de Ueno -- Este artículo fue actualizado a las 11:53 (hora del Este) con información a partir del tercer párrafo.

item.title: Siri AI's Biggest Upgrade Yet + John Ternus's First Apple Earnings Call
item.description:
Apple is finally bringing some of Siri's most ambitious AI capabilities to the iPhone. In this episode of Power On, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman and Vlad Savov break down the major changes coming with iOS 27.3, including Siri's new ability to control apps, carry out complex tasks and coordinate actions across multiple applications. They discuss how these improvements compare with AI agents from OpenAI and Meta, and why Apple still has a long way to go. Plus, Mark and Vlad analyze John Ternus's first earnings call as Apple's CEO, the company's strong iPhone sales, concerns about slowing growth and profit margins, and why more price increases could be coming. They also examine Apple's AI rollout in China and the privacy implications of new always-listening Apple Watch features.
Have a question for Mark? Email us at poweron@bloomberg.net or join the Power On Discord Subscribe to the Power On Newsletter at https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (Source: Bloomberg)

FAST

Nov 5 : LIV Golf, which shook up world golf in 2022, will liquidate after losing big-name players and the financing it needed to stay alive, the breakaway circuit said on Thursday. Throughout the wind-down process, LIV Golf said it would remain open to, and continue to consider any offers from third parties that could get more value from its assets. "In light of the current circumstances, we believe shifting toward an orderly wind-down is the most responsible path forward for the League at this time," Gene Davis and Jon Zinman of LIV Golf board’s special committee said in a press release. LIV Golf had secured $300 million of potential financing from BC Partners to allow the staging of tournaments in 2027 but scrapped the plan after a number of notable players opted not to commit to the league.

The future of LIV Golf had been in question after the circuit lost financial support from the deep-pocketed Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund beyond the now-completed 2026 season. Leading golfers like former world number one Jon Rahm announced their departures from LIV Golf after it filed for bankruptcy protection in September. LIV Golf sent shockwaves through the sport when it burst onto the scene in June 2022 with a mix of star power and past-their-prime veterans who signed lucrative contracts to appear in tournaments with guaranteed paydays. MAJOR CHAMPIONS The PGA Tour refused to let members compete in LIV Golf events, and suspended defecting golfers who included major champions like Bryson DeChambeau, Dustin Johnson, Brooks Koepka and Phil Mickelson. Those suspensions triggered a wave of bitter legal battles, including an antitrust lawsuit in which DeChambeau, Mickelson and others accused the PGA Tour of using monopoly power to penalize independent contractors. Critics decried LIV Golf as a vehicle for Saudi Arabia to improve its reputation and deflect criticism of its human rights record. The Saudi government denies accusations of human rights abuses. In June 2023, the PGA Tour and the Saudi fund again stunned the world of golf by announcing a framework to form one unified commercial entity, and end the litigation. As talks stalled, the PGA Tour even enlisted Donald Trump in the hope the US president, an avid golfer whose courses have hosted multiple LIV events, could broker a deal. The PGA Tour ultimately rejected the Saudi fund's offer to invest $1.5 billion on condition that LIV Golf would remain intact and fund governor Yasir Al-Rumayyan would co-chair the PGA Tour Enterprises' board. In late April, after pouring more than $5 billion into LIV Golf, the Saudi fund said the circuit no longer fitted its investment strategy, and it would pull funding after the 2026 season. "Building a global platform designed to bring new, younger, and more diverse fans to the sport of golf has been the round of a lifetime for all of us," LIV Golf CEO Scott O’Neil said. "LIV Golf was fun, demanding, inspiring, at times challenging — but always rewarding."

Source: Reuters

item.title: S&P/TSX composite down nearly 500 points, U.S. stock markets also fall
item.description: Canada’s main stock index was down nearly 500 points, weighed down by losses in the technology and base metal sectors, while U.S. stocks also fell.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: TORONTO — Canada’s main stock index was down nearly 500 points, weighed down by losses in the technology and base metal sectors, while U.S. stocks also fell in late-morning trading. The S&P/TSX composite index was down 476.02 points at 35,865.38 a day after stock markets in Canada and the United States posted big gains following the U.S. midterm elections that saw Democrats take control of Congress. In New York, the Dow Jones industrial average was down 1,136.98 points at 52,219.14. The S&P 500 index was down 212.50 points at 7,476.12, while the Nasdaq composite was down 1,019.48 points at 24,717.03. The Canadian dollar traded for 71.44 cents US compared with 71.63 cents US on Wednesday. The December crude oil contract was up US$2.28 at US$90.40 per barrel. The December gold contract was up US$29.80 at US$4,102.80 an ounce. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 5, 2026.

item.title: Quiebra de Ueno Bank podría dejar sin presidente a Paraguay: el juicio a Santiago Peña
item.description: La Cámara de Diputados de Paraguay debate este jueves un pedido de juicio político contra el presidente Santiago Peña por la crisis de Ueno Bank. La bancada oficialista del Partido Colorado adelantó ...
item.dc:creator: Redacción Bloomberg Línea
item.content:encoded: La Cámara de Diputados de Paraguay debate este jueves un pedido de juicio político contra el presidente Santiago Peña por la crisis de Ueno Bank. La bancada oficialista del Partido Colorado adelantó que acompañará la iniciativa, que podría avanzar hacia el Senado y abrir un proceso de destitución. El presidente de Diputados, Raúl Latorre, convocó a dos sesiones extraordinarias: la primera, prevista para las 10:00, tratará la acusación contra Peña; la segunda abordará el pedido contra el vicepresidente Pedro Alliana. Latorre anticipó que los legisladores oficialistas apoyarán el proceso contra el presidente, pero no contra Alliana. Los cinco diputados disidentes de Colorado Añetete también respaldarán la acusación contra Peña. VER MÁS: Partido Colorado de Paraguay apoya el juicio político contra el presidente Peña por Ueno Bank Para aprobar el pedido se necesitan dos tercios de los diputados presentes. Con los 80 legisladores en el recinto, hacen falta 53 votos; con el quórum mínimo de 41, alcanzaría con 28. Si la acusación prospera, el expediente pasará al Senado, donde se necesitarán 30 de los 45 votos para declarar culpable al presidente y destituirlo. Si no se alcanza esa mayoría, el caso será archivado. En caso de que Peña sea removido, Alliana asumiría la Presidencia. El eventual proceso penal es independiente del juicio político. VER MÁS: Moody’s advierte por el impacto de la crisis de Ueno Bank en el sistema financiero de Paraguay “La bandera colorada representa una historia de servicio al país; honrarla también significa actuar con valentía cuando la patria lo exige”, escribió el expresidente Horacio Cartes y acompañó el posteo con la imagen de un comunicado. Se trata de un duro revés para Peña, ya que Cartes es su padrino político. En dicho comunicado, Cartes expresa que la Asociación Nacional Republicana (más conocida como Partido Colorado) no estará “del lado del latrocinio de los fondos públicos, privados y de los jubilados”. Luego de esa introducción, añade: “Debemos pensar en la gente y en los valores que sostenemos desde el Partido Colorado”. Luego de ese primer párrafo el escrito sentencia: “Acompañamos el juicio político al presidente de la República, Santiago Peña, a los efectos de volver a reencauzar la institucionalidad de la República”. Por último, Cartes concluye: “La bandera colorada representa una historia de servicio al país: honrarla también significa actuar con valentía cuando la patria lo exige”. Quienes apuntan contra Santiago Peña sostienen que incurrió en conflictos de intereses al utilizar su posición como presidente para favorecer a Ueno Bank, entidad con la que había mantenido vínculos patrimoniales a través del grupo que la controlaba, del que se desvinculó en 2025. Los legisladores también lo acusan de haber impulsado cambios regulatorios que facilitaron el direccionamiento de fondos públicos y previsionales hacia el banco, incluidos recursos del Instituto de Previsión Social (IPS), que administra las jubilaciones paraguayas. VER MÁS: Peña pide la salida del presidente del Banco Central de Paraguay tras intervención de Ueno Bank Además, el pedido de juicio político le atribuye haber permitido excesos en los límites crediticios de Ueno Bank y encubierto irregularidades a través de los organismos de control, particularmente el Banco Central del Paraguay. Los impulsores de la iniciativa sostienen que esas decisiones expusieron fondos públicos y ahorros jubilatorios, generaron un beneficio patrimonial indebido para el mandatario y terminaron comprometiendo la confianza en el sistema financiero. Las acusaciones forman parte del libelo presentado por los legisladores y no constituyen hechos judicialmente probados.

item.title: Se derrumban las acciones de MercadoLibre en Wall Street: ¿qué motivos las empujan a la baja?
item.description: Los papeles del gigante tecnológico nacido en Argentina retroceden 14% intradiario luego de la presentación de resultados.
item.dc:creator: Juan Pablo Álvarez
item.content:encoded: Buenos Aires — Las acciones de MercadoLibre Inc. ( MELI ) sufrían un desplome superior al 12% en Wall Street este jueves 5 a las 14:04hs de Buenos Aires. La caída tiene, a grandes rasgos, dos motivaciones: por un lado, una aversión al riesgo global que está hundiendo al Nasdaq Composite un 5% y, por otra parte, un balance trimestral del gigante del comercio electrónico latinoamericano que dejó interrogantes en los inversores. Mercadolibre. Símbolo: MELI:UN. Clase de activo: equity. Lo concreto es que la acción de MercadoLibre opera, por estas horas, por debajo de los US$1.500. Este papel había tocado un máximo de US$2.613,63 el 30 de junio de 2025. VER MÁS: Acciones de MercadoLibre se hunden en Wall Street pese a cumplir con estimación de facturación “MELI crece, el margen todavía no”, titula un informe de la consultora Delphos Investment sobre los resultados de la compañía. Y detalla: “MELI volvió a crecer 41% a moneda constante, pero el margen operativo cayó por sexto trimestre seguido contra el año anterior, a 6,3%, y la carta cambió el argumento sin ponerle fecha a la recuperación. Los ingresos llegaron a US$10.750 millones, 45% más en dólares, mientras el resultado operativo bajó 6%, a US$676 millones. La ganancia subió 6%, a US$448 millones, pero solo porque la tasa de impuestos bajó de 33,8% a 25,5% y la pérdida cambiaria fue menor”. VER MÁS: Del RIGI al RUGE: De la Espriella adapta a Colombia el modelo de Milei de incentivos para inversiones El estudio agrega: “Lo leemos como un balance de crecimiento que todavía no muestra cuándo cobra. El trimestre cerró antes del balotaje en Brasil, así que no refleja el real más débil, que achica lo que MELI factura en dólares, ni el efecto de la elección sobre el crédito brasileño”. A futuro, desde Delphos Investment indicaron: “Lo que queda a seguir es el informe trimestral de los próximos días, que va a mostrar si la mora de más de 90 días siguió subiendo, y el margen del cuarto trimestre, con la temporada alta y la capacidad nueva ya funcionando”. VER MÁS: Vicepresidente del BCRA afirma que sectores que crecen tienen un “derrame absolutamente positivo” Aún así, la mayoría de bancos internacionales que siguen esta acción mantuvieron la recomendación de compra. Según datos compilados por Bloomberg, de las 11 entidades financieras que publicaron un informe sobre MercadoLibre luego del balance, 9 mantuvieron recomendaciones de compra o sobreponderación y otras dos se mantuvieron neutrales.

item.title: Share buybacks can add value for investors but can't 'rescue bad companies'
item.description: Share buybacks can lift returns or be a potential red flag, but finance experts say investors should look at the overall picture of how companies allocate their capital.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: TORONTO — Share buybacks can lift returns or be a potential red flag, but finance experts say investors should look at the overall picture of how companies allocate their capital to determine for themselves. When companies buy back their own stock, they often cancel those securities, reducing the number of outstanding shares available for trading in the market. That spreads profits over fewer shares, which can boost earnings per share metrics come earnings season and potentially lift the company’s stock price. “Some of the best and worst investments over the past few decades were heavy buyers of their own stock. Buybacks magnify what’s already there; it can be better for shareholders and good for businesses, but can’t rescue bad companies from their ultimate fates,” said Theresa Shutt, chief investment officer at Harbourfront Wealth Management. “You really need to look at the business itself.” Shutt said that buyback programs return excess cash to shareholders, in a way that offers the company more flexibility compared with hiking its dividend, which commits the company to making those payments at regular intervals. When a buyback occurs, she said shareholders get a bigger ownership stake “without spending a dollar.” Markets often view buybacks as a positive. “It can provide support for the share price, that increases demand for the stock, and that can lift the valuation as well,” she said. But not all buyback programs benefit investors. She said some companies also use buybacks as a form of “financial engineering” to artificially lift earnings per share metrics. Investors should also take note if companies are cutting back on investments, research and development or staffing to pay for buybacks, Shutt said. Using debt to fund buybacks is also a potential red flag. Brian Madden, chief investment officer with First Avenue Investment Counsel, said that while organic growth is the “Holy Grail” of equity investing, not all companies are going to be able to deliver growth at eye-popping levels and may look for other ways to add value for shareholders. For example, he said some companies may generate a lot of cash but have limited opportunities to reinvest that money into their operations — so they could use a buyback to reward investors instead. “One alternative would be just to let the cash pile up on your balance sheet, but that’s not ideal in the same way that having idle cash in your brokerage account is not ideal for an individual investor,” Madden said. “It’s an opportunity cost, and the way the opportunity cost manifests for a company is idle cash doesn’t earn a return.” When a company announces a new buyback program, Madden said the first step for investors is to ask themselves, “Is this anything new?” “Many companies announce share buybacks every year … for large companies it is the norm that most of them will have a normal course issuer bid authorization, which gives them the right but not the obligation to repurchase their shares,” Madden said. He said a good exercise for investors is to go back and see if a company has announced previous share buyback authorizations and find out how much of its own stock the firm actually repurchased. On the other hand, companies deciding not to purchase their shares may have other priorities, Madden said. “You also have to think about the company’s other uses for cash. Is it wise and prudent for them to be buying back their shares now, do they have upcoming bonds that they need to refinance, or do they have big capital expenditure commitments that they need to make good on,” he said. Overall, he said investors should zoom out when considering the merits or downsides of a buyback program. “In a unified way it’s all about evaluating how the company is at capital allocation,” Madden said. --- Daniel Johnson, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 5, 2026.

FAST

Nov 5 : OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, a model built to find and exploit security flaws, to a small group of vetted customers on Thursday, rating it "Critical" in cybersecurity under its safety framework.  The model is meant to help security researchers find vulnerabilities, test how they could be exploited and fix flaws before attackers do, OpenAI said, amid increasing attempts to misuse AI by malicious cyber actors. Here are more details: • OpenAI said its researchers used the model to find 81 previously unknown Firefox vulnerabilities that Mozilla classified as high severity. Mozilla has begun releasing fixes

• It also helped develop working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, including 588 that were previously unknown, OpenAI said • The company has also disclosed 304 critical Linux findings to maintainers, along with proposed patches • OpenAI has raised its cybersecurity classification for GPT-6 Cyber to "Critical" under its safety framework, from "High" for GPT-5.6 Cyber • The company said it is seeing more attempts to misuse AI, including by malicious cyber actors and groups seeking to distill its models • GPT-6 Cyber is available to select customers of Daybreak Red, OpenAI’s access tier for advanced, authorized security work such as penetration testing and exploit development, OpenAI said • Access to GPT-6 Cyber will be expanded to all approved Daybreak Red customers over the coming weeks, it added • OpenAI is also making its earlier GPT-5.6 Cyber model available to all Daybreak Red customers starting Thursday

item.title: AngloGold plans $900 million mine expansion amid stronger profit
item.description: The investment comes as the gold miner aims to incrementally increase production by the end of the decade.
item.dc:creator: Marina Meireles
item.content:encoded:
AngloGold plans $900 million mine expansion amid stronger profit

Marina Meireles | November 5, 2026 | 9:55 am Exploration   Top Companies   Africa   Latin America   Gold

Geita open pit mine, located in northwestern Tanzania, is AngloGold’s largest single gold mining operation. ( Image: AngloGold Ashanti )

AngloGold Ashanti (NYSE: AU) plans to invest up to $900 million in expanding brownfield operations across its portfolio, targeting a production increase of 300,000 ounces to 450,000 ounces by 2030.

The investments will focus on the Geita gold mine in Tanzania, Siguiri in Guinea and Cuiabá in Brazil, as well as the ongoing ramp-up at Obuasi in Ghana. The company expects the projects to generate real internal rates of return exceeding 35%, Reuters reported.

“These are high-return, capital efficient projects at our operating mines that are expected to provide high-margin ounces and unlock further value from our portfolio,” AngloGold Ashanti CEO, Alberto Calderon, said.

The plan is to use existing infrastructure and operational footprints to reduce risk and optimize capital intensity.

Geita will receive the larger portion of the funding, up to $580 million to raise output to 600,000 ounces by 2030. Cuiabá’s expansion will cost between $200 million and $250 million, adding about 75,000 ounces to its output.

Another $70 million will be put towards the Suguiri mine, looking to add another 100,000 ounces to its production.

Shares in AngloGold Ashanti were up 0.35% to $88.22 apiece by mid-day Thursday in New York, valuing the company at $44.6 billion.

Profit on the rise

AngloGold reported a 12% increase for its EBITDA for Q3 2026 to $1,568 million, from $1,400 million for Q3 2025.

The company said on its Q3 earnings release that the growth is supported by the increase in the average gold price received per ounce to $4,239/oz, from $3,490/oz in the same period in 2025.

AngloGold Ashanti said its full year gold production guidance of 2,800,000 ounces to 3,170,000 ounces is reaffirmed.

Its gold production was about 3.65% more costly than the previous quarter, costing $1,534 per ounce due gold royalties and higher fuel costs.

The company also reported that a worker died due to a rockfall at the Sukari underground mine in August 2026. Operations were suspended while investigations took place but have since resumed.

(With files from Reuters)

item.title: ＥＣＢ、12月利上げ必要か指標見極めへ＝ラガルド総裁
item.description: [ミラノ ５日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁は５日、１２月の理事会で利上げが必要かどうか判断す...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ、12月利上げ必要か指標見極めへ＝ラガルド総裁 1:47 配信

１０月２９日、フランクフルトのる欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）本部で記者会見するラガルド総裁　REUTERS/Heiko Becker（ロイター） [ミラノ ５日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁は５日、１２月の理事会で利上げが必要かどうか判断するため、各種経済指標を注視していると述べた。

ラガルド氏はミラノ証券取引所で開かれた学生向けの金融教育イベントで、「１２月（の次回理事会）までに多くの指標が発表される。利上げが必要か判断する上で大いに役立つ」と述べた。

現在の状況について「非常に厳しい」とし、エネルギーコストが「成長を押し下げ、物価を押し上げている」と語った。一方で、人工知能（ＡＩ）の発展が投資需要を押し上げ、ユーロ圏経済の底堅さを高めるのに役立っているとも指摘した。

ラガルド氏は「供給主導のショックと需要主導のショックを切り分けるのは非常に難しく、（金利という）手段をハンマーのように振り下ろさないよう、繊細さが求められる」との見解を示した。その上で「だが同時に、手段を講じなければならない。インフレ期待が制御不能になることや、インフレが経済全体に浸透して二次的な影響を生み出すことを防ぐ必要があるからだ」と語った。

ＥＣＢは１０月の理事会で金利据え置きを決定。エネルギー価格の急騰を受けてインフレリスクが高まっていると警告し、１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＥＣＢ「予防的」追加利上げへ、米イラン紛争長期化で アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 アングル：ＡＩの経済金融への影響、ＥＣＢフォーラムで希望と懸念が交錯 アングル：金融市場はＥＣＢのタカ派化見込む、イラン戦による油価高騰で コラム：求むＥＣＢ総裁、危機に強い革新者 11/6(金) 2:42 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

Nov 5 : Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin has delayed its New Glenn rocket launch into January 2027 after a major explosion forced delays earlier this year, two people familiar with the matter said on Thursday, citing an email sent by CEO Dave Limp to employees. Blue Origin did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. New Glenn, Blue Origin's flagship heavy-lift orbital rocket, has been grounded since exploding on the company's only launchpad in May, days before the planned launch of Amazon satellites.  The explosion badly damaged the Florida launchpad, where the 30-storey-tall (322 feet) rocket had lifted off three times since its 2025 debut. The company is now targeting January for its next launch after facing a series of delays reconstructing the launchpad in Florida, according to Limp's email on Wednesday, the sources said. The Financial Times first reported the news on Thursday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: BCE reports Q3 profit down from year ago, revenue edged higher
item.description: BCE Inc. reported a third-quarter profit attributable to common shareholders of $630 million as its operating revenue rose 2.2 per cent from a year ago.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: BCE Inc. reported a third-quarter profit attributable to common shareholders of $630 million as its operating revenue rose 2.2 per cent from a year ago. The company says the profit amounted to 67 cents per share for the quarter ended Sept. 30. The result compared with a profit of $4.50 billion or $4.84 per share a year ago when the company sold its minority stake in Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment to rival Rogers Communications Inc. On an adjusted basis, BCE said it earned 74 cents per share in its latest quarter, down from an adjusted profit of 79 cents per share in the same quarter last year. Operating revenue totalled $6.18 billion, up from $6.05 billion a year earlier. Last month, BCE announced a deal to sell a 49.9 per cent stake of a new company that will own and operate its wireless towers to Quebec investment manager La Caisse for $2.45 billion. The company said business markets revenue — comprised of income from both telecom and AI services — was $1.12 billion in the quarter, up 9.2 per cent from $1.03 billion a year ago. It said that encompassed 41 per cent growth of AI-powered solutions revenue, driven by strong demand for its Ateko and Bell Cyber brands. On the telecom side, BCE had a net gain of 24,110 postpaid mobile phone subscribers in its third quarter, up from 11,511 net activations during the same period a year earlier. It said the year-over-year gain reflected more customers transitioning from prepaid service, new subscribers from reaching a long-term government-sector mobile services contract, and lower customer churn — a measure of subscribers who cancelled their service. Postpaid customer churn was 1.06 per cent, an improvement from 1.13 per cent a year ago and Bell’s lowest level for the third quarter in four years. Bell cited lower market activity and its continued focus on customer service and retention. “In the year since our Investor Day 2025, Bell’s Q3 results show responsible investment in key growth areas and steadfast execution of our long-term priorities,” said BCE president and CEO Mirko Bibic in a news release. “Fibre and wireless continue to drive growth.” BCE’s mobile phone average revenue per user was $57.07, down 1.7 per cent from $58.04 a year ago. It said that decrease was due to multiple factors, including the CRTC’s prohibition on certain customer fees, which took effect in June. The regulator’s ban on activation, cancellation and modification fees have been met with resistance from Bell, along with Rogers and Telus, which have each introduced fees that the CRTC said could violate the new ban. The CRTC is in the midst of a review and said that if it determines the companies have violated the rules, they could face monetary penalties of up to $10 million. Bell also cited lower overage revenue from customers subscribing to unlimited and larger capacity data plans, along with lower international roaming revenue as customers both travel less and increasingly subscribe to plans that include U.S. and international roaming. --- CTV News, CP24 and BNN Bloomberg are owned by Bell Media, which is a division of BCE. Sammy Hudes, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 5, 2026.

FAST

LONDON: Ukraine's renewed attacks on Russian oil refineries add to Moscow's difficulty in addressing domestic fuel shortages while it ships diesel to international markets under an export deal with US President Donald Trump. The Ryazan oil refinery , one of R us sia's largest, appeared to have come under attack as part of a large drone strike overnight on ind us trial sites in the city, southeast of Moscow, according to a Reuters video analysis. If confirmed, it would be the second refinery to be hit this week following an attack on the Yaroslavl plant, northeast of Moscow, overnight on Monday (Nov 2), marking the breakdown of a pa us e in strikes. Ukraine's strikes on oil refineries this year forced large amounts of processing capacity in western R us sia offline, ca us ing fuel shortages that meant Moscow had to enforce fuel export bans from April onwards.

A ban on diesel exports has been lifted in part and the US struck the deal in October with the Kremlin to resume diesel exports to international markets when Trump was seeking to calm diesel prices ahead of the midterm elections on Nov 3, which Trump's Republican Party lost . The city of Ryazan had restored power supply earlier on Thursday as fires at the unnamed ind us trial sites were either contained or put out, the local governor said on social media.

US -R US SIA DIESEL CARGOES ARE IN FOC US At least six Russian diesel cargoes have broadcast that they plan transatlantic voyages, shipping data from Kpler and LSEG show, while two cargoes appeared to have changed course after being previo us ly bound for the US Atlantic coast. No Russian diesel cargo has arrived in the US since the deal , the data show. The first observed US -bound Russian shipment is expected to arrive in New York this weekend, but regulatory, legislative and sanctions concerns mean that its discharge is not guaranteed, Kpler analyst Matt Smith said. "These are commercial loadings, so naturally the details cannot be made public. All the diesel will find its buyers," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters on a daily conference call. Tankers often broadcast messages known as signals, such as "ATLANTIC COAST FOR ORDERS," indicating they are heading for the US Atlantic coast but have no confirmed discharge port, so the crew is awaiting instructions. Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev said Russian diesel cargoes destined for the US are continuing on course, in a post on X. There is no connection between diesel tankers changing course and the result of the US midterm elections, Peskov added.

item.content:encoded:

Tech-stock rout accelerates retreat from the AI trade

FILE PHOTO: A screen displays trading information outside the Nasdaq Market site in New York City, US, October 15, 2026. REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton/File Photo

06 Nov 2026 12:40AM

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 5 : Tech stocks were headed for their worst decline since June on Thursday, with the semiconductor index briefly falling by double digits in the latest autumn reckoning for the AI sector. The SOX fell as much as 11 per cent, its worst performance since March 2020, and the Nasdaq composite dropped as much as 5 per cent, a decline that would confirm a correction denoting a 10 per cent pullback from its high last month. Advanced Micro, Sandisk, Micron, Dell and Marvell Technology were among the more than a dozen large technology stocks down by double digits percentagewise.  It's the latest in a string of selloffs for the AI sector in what has been a bruising month since the Nasdaq's record close on October 6. Selling in stock and bond markets has reduced access to financing for many participants in the data-center buildout, while Tuesday's US elections brought the passage of dozens of nationwide ballot initiatives that stand to limit building in coming months and years.

COMMENTS: ADAM SARHAN, CHIEF EXECUTIVE OF 50 PARK INVESTMENTS IN NEW YORK "AI stocks are already in a private bear market that virtually nobody is talking about. If you look at the semiconductor index, it's down about 31 per cent from its 52-week high. The point is that many AI-related stocks are already deep into bear market territory, and very few people are discussing it."We're seeing large companies such as Apple cut back on AI spending because they are not seeing sufficient return on investment. The hype around AI was enormous, but now the market is asking whether customers will continue paying for these products and services. "I'm not using AI as much as I was six or twelve months ago, and I'm definitely not spending as much on it. As that revenue starts to dry up, investors are asking what the next bullish catalyst is. Right now, there doesn't appear to be a clear answer. In short, we're seeing the unwinding of the AI trade, while big technology stocks are moving deeper into correction territory."Looking ahead, there's a strong possibility of a significant policy shift in Washington. Different policies could create new winners and losers across sectors." WILL COMPERNOLLE, MACRO STRATEGIST, FHN FINANCIAL, CHICAGO: “It's really tempting to overinterpret or over extrapolate the first few hours of moves yesterday morning, but we already see that people continue to digest it, and they're all moving targets. Some of the narratives that seemed to be dominating yesterday reversed very quickly and we're still waiting for the dust to settle. It does look like there is this shift away from chipmaker stocks that is causing a bid for Treasuries. “Everything is tied to AI right now. The biggest market moves in October were, relatively speaking, pretty small tweaks in AI sentiment. But that is the catalyst. That is what determines demand for credit, economic growth, so many different things and I think after the midterms, a big question is how the outcome affects the trajectory of AI investment and we've already seen that rotation out of chip stocks and into hyperscalers. I think that shows that there are expectations for slower investment, but that could increase the viability of the hyperscalers, which seem to be in the middle of a kind of frenzied race to the bottom or top, depending on how you look at it. “I don't think there's been a bigger impact on Treasuries because it could be that people are already pricing this in, not only a Democratic sweep, but also, you know, Greg Abbott, I think last year, the current governor of Texas, said that he used to be a huge advocate for data centers and he wanted Texas to be the capital of it all and he imposed a moratorium on new permits in September. And to me, that reflects how the political environment already signaled a backlash regardless. "This week's results kind of codify it or underscore what was already happening, which is that people don't want these things in their backyard. Whether it's their understanding or misunderstanding of data centers’ impacts is beside the point. I think there's so much political pressure right now to slow down AI data centers and I think that is potentially the biggest driver of rates over the next couple of months.” PETER ANDERSEN, FOUNDER OF ANDERSEN CAPITAL MANAGEMENT IN BOSTON: “I think the sell-off first is unwarranted. And secondly, it's just the investors reorganizing their thoughts around the election results and how much policies will change to artificial intelligence and the associated technologies with that, such as the data center build outs. We've seen a lot of talk about delaying or moratoriums on certain states will not allow the data centers to be built. Investors are just trying to grapple with all that.” “It's going to take a while before investors actually get a clear picture. The election was yesterday, and it certainly will take some time to sink in as a general message and what the direction will be. So, for instance, I can see this as having a minimal impact. Say the data centers are not allowed to be built in the majority states of the United States. Our due diligence and interviewing with people that work in the data center construction have said they don't care. They'll go to Canada or Brazil, for instance. Brazil is calling asking if they can host these data centers. So there are certainly clear workarounds. The general investor has the enlightenment yet about what the alternatives are and there will be plenty of workarounds.” BRUCE ZARO, MANAGING DIRECTOR AT GRANITE WEALTH MANAGEMENT IN PLYMOUTH, MASSACHUSETTS: "It is really is kind of a secondary reaction to yesterday's election results... Yesterday's enthusiasm, in my view, was much less about who won or who lost, but the fact that we're now past that and we're looking through the windshield rather than the rearview mirror.  "Today, there's been a revisitation of that enthusiasm. And basically the semiconductors and the data center stocks are under immense pressure and all their ecosystems around them, because there's going to be a lot of pushback. "There's going to be a lot of pushback about those data centers being geographically located in someone's backyard, straining the power grid, straining the water systems. And so, although there are a number of data centers already approved, there are still a lot to be permitted. There's going to be a difficult road to get those permitted forthcoming. So I think that's what today's sell off is about." MARK HACKETT, CHIEF MARKET STRATEGIST FOR NATIONWIDE, DOWNINGTOWN, PENNSYLVANIA:"What is being blamed is relatively weak earnings from Qualcomm and ARM Holdings. That was a reminder that the fundamentals still matter but also the election likely putting a governor on the speed of the AI build out, that is particularly impactful to the semiconductor space and the neo-cloud space - the kind of more speculative areas of the tech market. "They're dragging pretty much everything else down. But the main driver here is very aggressive institutional selling and de-leveraging by hedge funds and more active institutional managers. Today, this is an emotional sell-off." MELISSA BROWN, GLOBAL HEAD OF INVESTMENT DECISION RESEARCH AT SIMCORP, NEW YORK: "Investors appear to be recognizing that some newly elected members of Congress and governors are looking to slow the pace of AI infrastructure development. While it seems unlikely that they will be able to stop it altogether, any slowdown would raise concerns because the AI growth story has largely depended on the rapid buildout of supporting infrastructure. That could create uncertainty for many companies exposed to the sector, at least in the near to medium term." SAMEER SAMANA, SENIOR GLOBAL MARKET STRATEGIST, WELLS FARGO INVESTMENT INSTITUTE, ST. LOUIS, MISSOURI: "What the market's focused on is that they priced in quite a bit of growth. And if that growth slows, then I think you have to switch from one investor base to a new investor base. The initial investor base was all about growth. They're going to move on somewhere else. The new investor base is the one who has to say, all right, I want healthy cash flow companies. Those are two different investor bases. Anything related to AI is down more than anything not related to AI. That handoff from growth investors to value investors may take some time because a lot of these stocks aren't exactly cheap yet. "Thematically, if AI is where growth has to be kind of moderated, that's probably where investors have to mark down their expectations and some may choose to exit entirely. "Yesterday was all about just we're all programmed to buy the dip. And when people saw that stock futures were selling off overnight last night, there's just now always a knee-jerk reaction to buy any dip. And because it's rewarded time and again by the market going higher like it did yesterday. The question is are there more dip buyers or are there more longer term investors for whom the story is meaningfully changing? And so yesterday, you can chalk one up to for the dip buyers, but today the long-term investors are the ones that are more meaningful." IPEK OZKARDESKAYA, SENIOR ANALYST AT SWISSQUOTE BANK, GENEVA, SWITZERLAND: "What we see in technology today is basically the unwinding of the AI trade if you look at the broader picture. Coming into this earnings season, there were worries that AI spending was too much. Those worries were already interfering with stronger-than-expected results from technology companies and strong results failed to improve appetite among tech investors. "We were already in a market mood that was not very appetising for technology due to the huge spending, higher borrowing costs and the fact that free cash flow levels at these hyperscalers are falling right now. They are issuing more equity and more bonds in order to finance additional AI spending, and both more equity and more bonds are negative for valuations. We were coming into this week and into the midterms with this sentiment already in place, and then the midterms were basically the last nail in the coffin.""There is now a chance that the two years of extra push from the Trump government for AI buildout will somehow be scaled back because there has been a lot about the AI trade that has been ignored by the current administration, whether we are talking about the impact on jobs, the economy or the environment. We suspect there is going to be some scrutiny on this aggressive AI buildout. "The fact that hyperscalers rallied yesterday on the possibility of an AI slowdown was actually interesting, as investors thought that if companies cannot slow down, maybe the government will slow them down. But these companies have spent so much money and put so much of their weight behind AI that a slowdown story may also come back and bite the hyperscalers. Many of these hyperscalers are also in the data-centre business, so they are very much tied to AI adoption and the fact that AI adoption accelerates."Looking at the market right now, we see that political worries are mounting and they are only adding to the previous worries that we already had in the sector. This is creating some panic and stress in the market right now, especially when you think that valuations were quite tight going into the earnings season. Strong earnings did not help and politics are not helping either. It is one more risk factor that comes and adds to the long list of things that could go wrong with the current pace of AI buildout."

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 5 : Global stocks fell on Thursday, weighed down by a sharp selloff in semiconductor shares after weak earnings from Qualcomm and concerns that a Democrat-controlled US Congress could slow investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure. Wall Street's main indexes tumbled, with the Nasdaq on track to confirm a correction from its record closing high. Technology stocks led declines among S&P 500 sectors, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index slumped 11 per cent. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 2.2 per cent, the S&P 500 slid 3.4 per cent, and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 5.2 per cent. Qualcomm shares dived 11 per cent after the company's smartphone chip sales missed Wall Street estimates.

"Disappointing earnings and the Dem sweep potentially slowing the AI buildout are pressing sentiment," said Mark Hackett, chief market strategist at Nationwide. "This is a volatile and cyclical group, and when sentiment shifts, the reactions are intense." Candidates in Tuesday's midterm elections who opposed data centre expansion and campaigned in part on moratoriums on new developments also secured victories in Texas and Georgia, adding to concerns about the outlook for AI-related infrastructure spending. The MSCI All-World index fell 2.5 per cent, having surrendered earlier gains, while Europe's STOXX 600 lost 0.67 per cent. "Hedge funds have been aggressively selling for weeks in this area. They were caught short yesterday and were forced to cover but today is a reflection that their bias is still to be short or to de-lever in the semiconductors and neoclouds," Hackett said. OIL REVERSES COURSE Brent crude futures was last up 2.58 per cent on the day, at $97 a barrel, as investors refocused on uncertainties about the future course of the US war with Iran. After Trump's Republican Party suffered heavy losses in the midterm elections on Tuesday, oil prices had tumbled. Trump acknowledged on Wednesday that the war played a role in Republicans' defeat and his vice president, JD Vance, was even more blunt on X: "The reason we lost is the war."  Bond prices eased from the day's highs, in line with the rebound in the crude price, leaving yields on benchmark 10-year US notes down 1.22 basis points on the day at 4.88 per cent.  In currencies, the dollar edged into positive territory, gaining on the euro, which held at $1.1222, and against the pound, which held at $1.3466 after the Bank of England raised interest rates for the first time since 2023 and signalled more may be necessary if the Iran war continues. Gold traded above $4,100 an ounce, having risen 5 per cent in two days, its largest two-day jump since early April.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 英開催のＧ２０サミット、プーチン氏は出席せず 制裁理由に＝バーナム首相
item.description: [ロンドン ５日 ロイター] - バーナム英首相は、英国の対ロシア制裁を理由に、ロシアのプーチン大統領が英国で開催される２０カ国・地域首脳会議（Ｇ２０サミット）
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ロンドン ５日 ロイター] - バーナム英首相は、英国の対ロシア制裁を理由に、ロシアのプーチン大統領が英国で開催される２０カ国・地域首脳会議（Ｇ２０サミット） に出席することはないとの見解を示した。英誌エコノミストが５日報じた。

同誌によると、バーナム氏は、ロシアはＧ２０加盟国であるため、プーチン氏の招待を取り消すことはできないし、取り消すこともないとした上で、「有効な制裁のため、（プーチン氏が）出席することはない」と述べた。

バーナム氏の事務所は、英国が２０２２年から科し始めたプーチン氏に対する制裁について、これ以上のコメントは控えた。

ルビオ米国務長官は９月、米政府が１２月にフロリダ州マイアミで開催するＧ２０会合にプーチン氏を招待したとし、同氏がトランプ米大統領や他の世界の首脳らと対話する機会になるとの考えを示した。

ロシアは、ウクライナへの全面侵攻を受けて西側諸国から孤立させようとする動きがあるにもかかわらず、依然としてＧ２０加盟国にとどまっている。開催国の首脳は従来、年次サミットに全加盟国を招待するのが慣例となっている。

来年のＧ２０サミットは、バーナム氏が市長を務めた英マンチェスターで１１月に開催される。

item.title: ホルムズ海峡でタンカー3隻被害、米中間選挙後も海運リスク続く
item.description: [ドバイ ５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ ５日 ロイター] - イランは５日、ホルムズ海峡でさらに３隻のタンカーが損傷したと発表した。トランプ米大統領がイラン戦争を巡り中間選挙で有権者から厳しい審判を下された後も、紛争が未解決である限り、海運は今後も危険にさらされ続けることが鮮明となった。

英海事機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は、４日遅くに１隻の船舶が正体不明の飛翔体２発の攻撃を受けたと発表した。ＵＫＭＴＯによると、今月１日以降、少なくとも５隻の船舶が被害を報告。同機関が開戦以降で月間最多の３５隻が被害を受けたとする１０月とほぼ同じペースとなった。

トランプ氏率いる共和党の中間選挙での大敗を受け、政権内では紛争の政治的代償について厳しい見直しが始まっている。バンス副大統領は４日、Ｘへの投稿で、トランプ大統領が進めた対イラン戦争との距離を置く姿勢を示し、選挙で敗北した理由は全面的にイラン戦争に原因があったとの認識を示した。

これに対し、イランのガリバフ国会議長は５日、トランプ氏にさらなる空爆を計画させることで、トランプ氏が「負けが込んだギャンブラー」のように深みにはまるのをバンス氏が許していると指摘。戦争が誤りだとバンス氏が考えているのなら、トランプ氏を説得して中止させるべきだとし「上司にそう言ってみたらどうだ」と皮肉を込めて非難した。

イラン当局者は先週以降、カタールの仲介者と会談を重ね、敵対行為の終結に向けた提案を協議している。ただ、これまでのところ、和平合意の妨げとなってきた主要な問題について、双方とも進展を発表していない。

item.title: 緩やかな利上げ妥当、インフレなお高水準＝米リッチモンド連銀総裁
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ５日 ロイター] - 米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁は５日、需...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
緩やかな利上げ妥当、インフレなお高水準＝米リッチモンド連銀総裁 0:50 配信

２０２５年１１月撮影　REUTERS/Elizabeth Frantz（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ５日 ロイター] - 米リッチモンド地区連銀のバーキン総裁は５日、需要が堅調で失業率が低く、幅広い分野で物価上昇圧力が続く中でインフレ率が連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が目標とする２％を上回る水準で高止まりしていることを踏まえると、利上げを緩やかなペースで進めていくことが理にかなうとの考えを示した。

バーキン氏はノースカロライナ州シャーロットで開かれたリッチモンド地区連銀主催の企業向け会議で「この１年半にわたり直面してきたコスト圧力は、関税に始まり、石油やディーゼル燃料、さらには医療費にも及んでいる」と指摘。「これらは幅広い分野に及ぶコストで、極めて目に見えやすい。誰もがその影響を受けている」と述べた。

その上で「インフレ率は依然として高すぎる。加速しているとは聞いていないが、鈍化しているという話も聞かない」と述べ、「政策への示唆は極めて明確だ。問題はそのペースにある。緩やかな対応が理にかなう」と語った。

ＦＲＢは１０月２７─２８日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で１０対２で金利据え置きを決定。次回のＦＯＭＣは１２月８─９日に開く。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：米中間選挙の民主勝利、市場に新たな波乱　外交・財政リスク警戒 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か 11/6(金) 0:50 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

Nov 5 : India's opening one-day international against Sri Lanka on December 13 has been moved from Delhi to Visakhapatnam after the Delhi and District Cricket Association asked for a venue change, the Board of Control for Cricket in India said on Thursday. The BCCI said the DDCA cited "potential weather disruption and the proposed renovation work at the (Arun Jaitley) stadium" as reasons for seeking the switch. The match would have been the capital's first ODI since the 2023 World Cup. It will now be held at the ACA-VDCA Cricket Stadium in Visakhapatnam. According to Cricbuzz, the concerns raised by the DDCA are also linked to Delhi's air quality during December, with officials keen to avoid a repeat of the issues during India's test match versus Sri Lanka in 2017.

Delhi has not staged an international match in December since that test, when several Sri Lanka players wore masks on the field because of severe air pollution. Reuters has reached out to the DDCA for comment. Air pollution becomes a severe problem for the Delhi region around this time of the year when cold, dense air traps emissions from vehicles, construction sites and crop waste burning, pushing pollution levels to the highest in the world and exposing residents to serious respiratory risks. Fireworks during the Hindu festival of Diwali, which falls on November 8 this year, worsen the pollution in India. Sri Lanka will play three ODIs and three Twenty20 Internationals on the tour from December 13 to 27. The remaining ODIs will be held in Bengaluru and Ahmedabad, while the T20Is will be staged in Rajkot, Cuttack and Pune respectively.

Source: Reuters

Nov 5 : Following are reactions after Portugal great Cristiano Ronaldo, the all-time leading scorer in men's international soccer, announced his retirement from the national team on Thursday. PORTUGUESE FOOTBALL FEDERATION "Every drop of sweat, every decisive goal, and every captain's arm-band he wore with honour on the field reflected his unconditional love for our jersey. His dedication and his legacy transcend the four lines of the field. "Ronaldo has raised Portugal's profile and inspired generations of young people who dream of following in his footsteps; for many of us, he is the greatest player of all time!..."

AL-NASSR, RONALDO'S CURRENT CLUB "It's not just a chapter — it's history you've shaped. You're an icon to the entire world, not just Portugal. Portugal is in your heart, and you are in the hearts of the world. A page has turned, but there is still history left for us to write together at your home, Al-Nassr." MANCHESTER UNITED, RONALDO'S FORMER CLUB "Congratulations on an incredible international career." JORGE JESUS, PORTUGAL COACH "This is all his decision. We already had the opportunity to talk about this before the first call-up. I asked him to stay, to stay with me because I needed him to be by my side, but I have to accept his decision," Jesus told Canal 11. "He is a world reference, a reference for Portugal, a reference for the national team. He is a player who, throughout these years, has given a lot to the national team. He is a symbol for Portuguese youth. Most of his fans are young. "I had the opportunity to share the experience of working with him for a year at Al-Nassr. Therefore, he will always be a reference for our national team, for our people, for our history." BRUNO FERNANDES, PORTUGAL AND MANCHESTER UNITED MIDFIELDER "Thank you for the inspiration. It was a privilege to be able to share great moments with our national team alongside my childhood idol." DIOGO DALOT, PORTUGAL AND MANCHESTER UNITED FULLBACK "They don't know that dreams are a constant in life..." "Portugal's history tells us that we are a people who have never accepted limits, unafraid of uncharted seas or weathering storms. We were and are shaped by achievements, sacrifices, tears, and sweat... By dreams that seem impossible — until someone has the courage to make them a reality. You did it. You made us believe, dream, and achieve! "A legacy that will be remembered not only for the trophies or the goals, but also for the path you paved for all those who came after you. Your passion and determination to represent our country is something I'll never forget and that will stay with me forever. "I'm immensely proud of everything you've done for our national team! Thank you, idol." PEPE, FORMER PORTUGAL AND REAL MADRID CENTRE BACK "It was more than just soccer. Thanks for everything, Cris." GIANNI INFANTINO, FIFA PRESIDENT "Few players have ever touched the heart of football fans around the world quite like Cristiano. A career defined by extraordinary talent, relentless determination and an unwavering desire to push the boundaries of what is possible... "Cristiano has achieved milestones that may never be matched but his greatest legacy goes far beyond records, trophies and goals... "Thank you, Cristiano, for the passion, the unforgettable moments and the immense contribution you have made to our beautiful game proudly wearing the "Selecao" shirt. "Your international career will forever be part of football's history." (Compiled by Pearl Josephine Nazare in Bengaluru;Editing by Toby Davis)

Source: Reuters

FAST

TOLEDO, Spain, Nov 5 : Family, friends and teammates gathered in the village of Navahermosa on Thursday for the funeral of Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel, who died following an on-field collision. De Miguel collided with Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono during Monday's match and was taken to intensive care. Tenerife confirmed De Miguel's death on Tuesday morning. The Tenerife squad, club staff and majority shareholder Rayco Garcia attended the funeral, along with Royal Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) President Rafael Louzan, Spain coach Luis de la Fuente, Real Madrid President Florentino Perez and Atletico Madrid CEO Miguel Angel Gil Marin. De Miguel's coffin was carried out of San Miguel Arcangel church in a procession to the cemetery.

De Miguel's family thanked well-wishers for their support in a statement read by his agent Manuel Hernandez before the funeral. "Feeling so much affection for Jesus and seeing the impact he had on so many people is something we will always carry with us," the family said in the statement read by Hernandez. "Jesus leaves a void that is impossible to fill, but also cherished memories for all of us who were fortunate enough to share our lives with him. Thank you for loving him and for standing by us." Spanish police have opened a routine investigation into De Miguel's death. Andorra released a statement on Wednesday, in which Owono said: "These are the most difficult days of my life." Tenerife's match against Granada and Andorra's game with Mallorca, both scheduled for this weekend, have been postponed. Tenerife's main rivals, Las Palmas, will play their fixture against Eldense on Sunday in blue and white colours, traditionally worn by Tenerife, as a tribute to De Miguel. Garcia invited fans to Tenerife's stadium on Saturday to pay their respects to De Miguel in what he called 'the last goodbye'. LALIGA TO GO AHEAD The Spanish Footballers’ Association said on Thursday it had requested the suspension of this weekend's round of matches. LaLiga later confirmed that fixtures in the first and second divisions would go ahead, with the exception of Andorra-Mallorca, Granada-Tenerife and Castellon-Eibar. De Miguel spent two-and-a-half years at Castellon before moving to Tenerife in 2025, and LaLiga accepted the club's request to postpone their match. A minute's silence will be observed before each game that goes ahead, while the referee will stop play at the first interruption after the ninth minute, in recognition of the number nine shirt De Miguel wore for Tenerife. The tributes were agreed by LaLiga, Liga F, the RFEF, players and clubs.

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場・午前＝ナスダック3％超反落、半導体・データセンター株に売り 0:26 配信

2026年9月28日に撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） ［５日　ロイター］ - ５日午前の米国株式市場は、大幅反落した。半導体・データセンター関連株が下落し、ナスダック総合指数が３％超下げている。民主党が中間選挙で圧勝したことを受け、投資家は、データセンター業界への監視が強まり開発が減速する可能性を懸念している。

多額のＡＩ投資に対する投資家の不安を映すバロメーターとなってきた「ネオクラウド」株は下落。コアウィーブが約３％、ネビウスが約６％、それぞれ下落した。

ＵＢＳのアナリストは、２０２８年に見込まれる米国のデータセンターの新規増設容量の約３割が、建設の一時停止によって危険にさらされる可能性があると試算した。

データセンター運営企業のアプライド・デジタル、サイファー・デジタル、ＩＲＥＮは、それぞれ約５％下落した。

建設の恩恵を受ける電力会社や設備供給企業にも売りが広がった。ＧＥベルノバは１．５％安、コンステレーション・エナジーは１％安となった。

一部のハイパースケーラーは逆行高となった。データセンター建設の減速で大手ハイテク企業のＡＩ支出が抑制され、既存施設の価値が高まるとの見方からだ。

アマゾン・ドット・コムは１．９％高、アルファベットは１．６％高で推移している。

一方、クアルコムは、四半期のスマートフォン向け半導体売上高が市場予想を下回り、９％急落した。半導体メーカーのエヌビディア、インテル、ブロードコムは３．２─４．９％下落した。

米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラと米宇宙関連企業スペースＸの株価は下落幅を拡大。直近ではそれぞれ９．７％、７．５％安で推移している。

FAST

Nov 5 : The Nasdaq slid more than 10 per cent from its record close on Thursday, on track to confirm a correction as worries over massive AI spending and heightened scrutiny of data-center expansion rattled tech stocks. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index fell nearly 4 per cent to 24,712.60, more than 10 per cent below its record closing high of 27,599.89 reached on October 6. Thursday's slide erased the previous session's gains after Democrats swept both houses of Congress, as investors weighed the prospect of greater scrutiny of further AI infrastructure buildout. "When you go from full unified control under one party to full unified control under another party that can also represent quite a bit of uncertainty, discontinuity and abrupt change to policy," said Sameer Samana, senior global market strategist at Wells Fargo Investment Institute.
